summary: The B12X PCIe all-reduce warns when the NVIDIA driver runs without the ForceP2P override, and can refuse to start without it
compatibility: No user action required. Set VLLM_PCIE_REQUIRE_P2P_OVERRIDE=1 to keep the B12X PCIe all-reduce disabled (NCCL is used) while the override is missing.
details: On GPUs behind CPU root ports the driver stages GPU-to-GPU kernel accesses through system memory unless NVreg_RegistryDwords carries ForceP2P. The one-shot all-reduce is then much slower than NCCL at decode sizes, and nothing reported it.
The state is read from /proc/driver/nvidia/params. When it cannot be read, nothing changes.
